properties/action: start initializes a watch; list returns all watches; wait waits for readiness; cancel ends only the watch; acknowledge removes a ready result from reminders.
properties/job_id: Managed background job ID; required for start. Use the ID from run_command or command_jobs.
properties/monitor_id: Monitor ID returned by start; required for wait, cancel, and acknowledge.
properties/pattern: Optional case-sensitive literal substring, 1 to 256 characters. Omit to watch job completion.
properties/stream: Output stream to match: stdout, stderr, or both (default). Result tails include both streams.
properties/repeat: Keep matching until job completion or timeout instead of completing on the first match; defaults to false. Requires pattern.
properties/timeout: Watch lifetime in seconds for start (default 30, maximum 600), or wait duration (capped at 30). Does not alter the command timeout.
